title: 第434章 权衡利弊第433章 王道怀柔
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
“我感觉，我们还能在改一点。”苏少卿道。
“说说看。”雅曼闻言顿时有了兴趣。
“前辈，你刚才说，收买那些门下弟子的心，让各宗主想反抗也没有人支持，但若是门下弟子只跟随各宗主呢。”苏少卿道。
“这……”雅曼闻言，一时之间竟然想不到解决办法。
“他们明面上能用的理由，无非也就是把哲叔比作黑山，不过说实话，哲叔所作所为，其实和黑山也确实差不了多少，所以我想，若是想要彻底让他们无法反抗，就要从根源上入手，他们不是说哲叔像黑山吗，那我们就要做的和黑山不一样，让他们反抗的理由站不住脚，这样才能从根本上断绝他们反抗的源头，让他们想反抗都反抗不起来。”苏少卿道。
“想法不错，但你要如何解决。”雅曼问道。
“釜底抽薪，既然要改革，那就索性改革的彻底的一点，我们把长渊宗也直接删去名号，设立锻司，专职负责宗门内的防御器具打造，若是有外敌入侵，与战司一同正面迎敌。”苏少卿看着雅曼继续说道：“您原本的方案，只是拆分其他宗门设五大司职，但唯独长渊宗保留原有名号，凌驾所有人之上。”
“在许风，易水华等人的眼中，就算是保留了其原有的道统传承，也终究是长渊吞并了其余势力，他们所有人都是长渊宗的依附者，骨子里永远存在着一种屈辱感，这种屈辱感或许可以按照您的方案有所消退，但终究是个隐患，如果将长渊宗也一并删除名号，六大宗门共同建立一个新的宗门，这样一来，便不会存在征服者与被征服者的区别，对外也不再是长渊收纳万宗，而是所有势力自愿融合共建新道统，如此，便可以彻底根除旧宗门尊卑隔阂。”
“哲叔此番靠武力强行压服众人，本身就自带着强权掠夺的观感，而我们现在主动削去长渊独一无二的地位，主动放下征服者的特权，对外塑造大公无私，一心为白夜谷的格局，彻底避开和黑山教强权独霸一模一样的诟病，也杜绝黑山教余孽借舆论挑拨，仇视长渊的机会。”苏少卿说完，看向雅曼，想要听听她的意见。
雅曼听完苏少卿的话，无奈的轻轻摇了摇头。
“怎么了？”苏少卿见雅曼摇头，问道。
“你的想法很好，也确实是当下的最优解，如果这次统一全白夜谷的宗门，不是长渊宗的话，你这套方案简直就是完美。”雅曼道。
“为什么？”苏少卿有些不理解雅曼的话。
“你有没有想过一个问题，你这样做，谢广鹏他们会怎么想。”雅曼反问道。
苏少卿闻言，瞬间惊醒。
“长渊宗此战出力最多，如今却要和受损，出力更少的宗门一同废除传承百年的宗门名号，谢广鹏他们会答应吗，况且谢广鹏他们一众长老扎根长渊数十年，对宗门归属感极重，很难接受删去名号。”
“而且在白夜谷内，除去长渊宗外，其余宗门都只有宗主，没有长老一职，就算有，长老的权力也远不及宗主，可以说，全宗门上上下下大大小小的事务基本都是宗主一个人说了算，而长渊宗不同，宗主之位丢失已经很久了，宗门大大小小的事务都是一众长老说了算，宗主之位，可有可无，你感觉就凭你现在在宗门内的话语权，就算你真的说服了谢广鹏他们，长渊宗门下的弟子会怎么想，一个突然升上来的名不见经传的宗主，上来就要断了自己家的传承，他们会不会寒心，到时候，长渊宗自己内部就会先出现分裂，还谈何统一。”雅曼道。
“你这个方案，放到白夜谷其他任何一个宗门，都是最优解，但唯独长渊宗，不行，长渊宗的权利太分散了，而且你就那么确定，哲会同意你这么做吗，哲的想法，可从来都是以长渊宗为标杆，威慑众人，若是你在长渊宗内待的时间长一点，威望稍微提高一点，说不定还真的能行，现在吗，还是看清现实吧。”雅曼道。
“可是，改革不彻底，日后再来，只怕阻力会更大。”苏少卿道。
“那也没有办法，现在改革也很难了，全靠着哲的实力威慑，况且，哲当上宗主，也是依靠他师父的面子，还有自己的实力，若是你真的敢动长渊宗，你猜谢广鹏他们会不会不顾及哲的面子，毕竟，你可是亲手给他们打造出了一尊大杀器啊。”雅曼道。

苏少卿闻言，不再说话。
对呀，暴风雷霆现在可是在谢广鹏手里，苏少卿虽然是创造者，却也无法操控机甲，若是真的逼急了，暴风雷霆对自己人出手，也是有这个可能的，有暴风雷霆在，哲在长渊宗的威望，只会直线下降。
“一切都是天意，不完美之事，十有八九，你的上位本就已经让人气愤不已了，若是还要如此大动干戈的改革，只会适得其反，你现在是长渊宗的宗主，在他们眼里，你首先要考虑的，必须是长渊宗的利益，这也是你在长渊宗建功唯一的道路，不要辜负了哲的期望啊。”雅曼起身拍了拍苏少卿的肩膀，离开房间，留苏少卿一人在房间里决定着该如何做。
天音堂。
哲从天而降，稳稳的落到天音堂大殿。
content_en:
"I feel like we can still make some changes." Su Shaoqing said.
"Tell me about it." Yaman suddenly became interested after hearing this.
"Senior, you just said that you bought the hearts of those disciples so that no one would support the sect leaders if they wanted to resist. But what if the disciples only follow the sect leaders?" Su Shaoqing said.
"This..." Upon hearing this, Yaman couldn't think of a solution for a moment.
"The reason they can use on the surface is to compare Uncle Zhe to Montenegro. But to be honest, what Uncle Zhe did is actually not much different from Montenegro. So I think if you want to completely make them unable to resist, you have to attack the root cause. "Shou, didn't they say that Uncle Zhe is like Montenegro? Then we have to do something different from Montenegro to make their reasons for resistance untenable. Only in this way can we fundamentally cut off the source of their resistance and make them unable to resist even if they want to." Su Shaoqing said.
"It's a good idea, but how are you going to solve it?" Yaman asked.
"To take a step back from the bottom of the cauldron, since we need to reform, let's simply make the reform thorough. We will directly delete the name of Changyuan Sect and set up a blacksmithing department to be responsible for the creation of defensive equipment within the sect. If there is an invasion from a foreign enemy, we will face the enemy head-on with the war department." Su Shaoqing looked at Yaman and continued: "Your original plan was to split the other sects into five major responsibilities, but only Changyuan Sect retains its original name and is above everyone else."
"In the eyes of Xu Feng, Yi Shuihua and others, even if they retain their original Taoist heritage, Changyuan has annexed the other forces after all. All of them are dependents of the Changyuan Sect, and there will always be a sense of humiliation in their bones. This sense of humiliation may be subsided according to your plan, but it is a hidden danger after all. , if the name of Changyuan Sect is also deleted, and the six major sects jointly establish a new sect, then there will be no distinction between the conquerors and the conquered, and Changyuan will no longer accept ten thousand sects from the outside, but all forces will voluntarily merge to build a new sect. In this way, the hierarchy between the old sects can be completely eradicated. "
"Uncle Zhe relied on force to subjugate everyone this time, which inherently carries the perception of power and plunder. But now we are taking the initiative to deprive Changyuan of his unique status, proactively let go of the privileges of the conqueror, and portray selflessness and single-mindedness to the outside world. In order to completely avoid the criticism of the Black Mountain Sect's power and dominance for the structure of the White Night Valley, it also prevents the remnants of the Black Mountain Sect from using public opinion to instigate hatred against Zhang Yuan." After Su Shaoqing finished speaking, he looked at Yaman, wanting to hear her opinion.
After listening to Su Shaoqing's words, Yaman gently shook his head helplessly.
"What's wrong?" Su Shaoqing asked as Yaman shook his head.
"Your idea is very good, and it is indeed the best solution at the moment. If the sects that unify all the White Night Valley this time are not the Changyuan Sect, your plan will be perfect." Yaman said.
"Why?" Su Shaoqing didn't understand Yaman's words.
"Have you ever thought about what Xie Guangpeng and the others would think if you did this?" Yaman asked.
When Su Shaoqing heard this, he woke up instantly.
"The Changyuan Sect contributed the most in this battle, but now they have to abolish the sect name that has been passed down for centuries together with the damaged sects who have contributed less. Will Xie Guangpeng and the others agree? Besides, Xie Guangpeng and his elders have been rooted in Changyuan for decades and have a strong sense of belonging to the sect. It is difficult to accept the deletion of the name."
"And in Baiye Valley, except for the Changyuan Sect, the other sects only have the sect leader, and there is no elder position. Even if there is, the power of the elder is far less than that of the sect leader. It can be said that the sect leader alone has the final say on all matters of all sizes, and the Changyuan Sect does not At the same time, the position of the sect leader has been lost for a long time. The elders have the final say on all matters of the sect. The position of the sect leader is dispensable. You feel that just with your right to speak in the sect now, even if you really persuade Xie Guangpeng and the others, what will happen to the disciples of the Changyuan Sect?I wonder if they would be disappointed if an unknown sect leader who suddenly rose to the top would cut off the inheritance of his family. By then, the Changyuan Sect itself would be divided first, and there would be no talk of unification. Yaman said.
"Your plan is the best solution for any other sect in Baiye Valley, but it won't work for the Changyuan Sect. The power of the Changyuan Sect is too scattered, and you are so sure that Zhe will agree to what you do. Zhe's idea has always been to use the Changyuan Sect as a benchmark to intimidate everyone. If you stay in the Changyuan Sect for a longer time and your prestige is slightly improved, maybe it can really work. Now, let's see the reality clearly. Yaman said.
“However, if the reform is not thorough, I’m afraid the resistance will be even greater if we try again in the future. " Su Shaoqing said.
"There is no way, and reform is very difficult now. It all depends on Zhe's strength as a deterrent. Besides, Zhe became the sect leader because of his master's face and his own strength. If you really dare to touch the Changyuan Sect, do you think Xie Guangpeng and the others will ignore Zhe's face? After all, you personally built a big killer weapon for them. Yaman said.
When Su Shaoqing heard this, he stopped talking.
Yes, Storm Thunder is now in the hands of Xie Guangpeng. Although Su Shaoqing is the creator, he cannot control the mecha. If it is really pressed, it is possible for Storm Thunder to take action against one of its own people. With Storm Thunder around, Zhe's prestige in Changyuan Sect will only plummet.
"Everything is God's will and imperfection. Nine times out of ten, your rise to power has already made people very angry. If you want to carry out such drastic reforms, it will only be counterproductive. You are now the leader of Changyuan Sect. In their eyes, your first priority must be the interests of Changyuan Sect. This is also the only way for you to make achievements in Changyuan Sect. Don't let down Zhe's expectations. Yaman stood up, patted Su Shaoqing on the shoulder, and left the room, leaving Su Shaoqing alone in the room to decide what to do.
Tianyintang.
Zhe fell from the sky and landed steadily in the main hall of Tianyintang.
